scripts.lint: pnpm --dir apps/web lint && uv run ruff check backend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck && uv run mypy backend/src
scripts.test: pnpm --dir apps/web test && uv run pytest backend/tests
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && uv run ruff format --check backend && pnpm --dir apps/web build && pnpm test:e2e && python3 scripts/verify_no_secrets.py
